title: Institutional relationships in urban green space governance in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Roles, interactions and policy implications for sustainable management
title_zh: 加纳大塔马利城市绿地治理中的制度关系：角色、互动及可持续管理的政策启示
title_primary: 加纳大塔马利城市绿地治理中的制度关系：角色、互动及可持续管理的政策启示
title_secondary: Institutional relationships in urban green space governance in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Roles, interactions and policy implications for sustainable management
authors: Abdulai Abdul-Hamid, Kwabena Obeng Asiama, Frank Gyamfi-Yeboah, Yakubu Ibrahim, Romanus Dogkubong Dinye
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) in rapidly urbanizing African cities are increasingly threatened by weak governance systems and institutional inefficiencies. This study investigates how formal and informal institutional arrangements shape governance responsibilities, interagency coordination, and UGS management in the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area, Ghana. Using an institutional theory framework, the research adopted a qualitative case study approach, involving 54 semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations across selected communities: Sagnarigu, Nyohini, Gumbeheni, Taha, and Kukuo. The findings reveal that UGS governance in Tamale operates through a hybrid institutional system in which statutory planning frameworks coexist with customary land tenure systems. Traditional authorities, particularly chiefs, play a significant role in land allocation and initiating planning processes, while state institutions primarily provide regulatory oversight. Although this arrangement creates opportunities for legitimacy and local participation, it also generates ambiguities in authority, weak accountability, and poor coordination among stakeholders. Collaboration tends to be stronger within institutional groupings than between local actors and formal spatial planning institutions. The study further identifies critical institutional constraints, including overlapping mandates, limited public participation, and severe staffing shortages in planning and environmental agencies. Specifically, only one of the required five physical planning officers and one of the four required development control officers were available during the study period. These institutional weaknesses, compounded by rapid urbanization and increasing land-use pressures, contribute significantly to the decline of UGS. The study concludes that strengthening coordination, accountability, participation, and institutional capacity is essential for sustainable and inclusive UGS governance.
abstract_zh: 非洲快速城市化城市中的城市绿地（UGS）日益受到治理体系薄弱和制度效率低下的威胁。本研究探讨正式与非正式制度安排如何塑造加纳大塔马利都市区的治理责任、机构间协调及城市绿地管理。基于制度理论框架，研究采用定性案例研究方法，在选定的社区——萨格纳里古、尼奥希尼、贡贝赫尼、塔哈和库库奥——开展了54次半结构化访谈、文件分析和实地观察。研究发现，塔马利的城市绿地治理运行于一种混合制度体系中，法定规划框架与习惯土地保有制度并存。传统权威，尤其是酋长，在土地分配和启动规划进程中发挥重要作用，而国家机构主要提供监管监督。尽管这一安排为合法性和地方参与创造了机会，但也导致了权威模糊、问责薄弱以及利益相关者之间协调不力。协作在制度群体内部往往强于地方行动者与正式空间规划机构之间。研究进一步识别了关键制度制约因素，包括职责重叠、公众参与有限以及规划与环境机构严重的人员短缺。具体而言，在研究期间，所需五名实体规划官员中仅有一名到位，所需四名开发控制官员中也仅有一名在岗。这些制度弱点，加之快速城市化和日益增长的土地利用压力，显著加剧了城市绿地的退化。研究得出结论，加强协调、问责、参与和制度能力对于可持续和包容性的城市绿地治理至关重要。

title: Can We Build More Effective Place-Based Policies? Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 我们能否制定更有效的地域导向政策？理论与证据
title_primary: 我们能否制定更有效的地域导向政策？理论与证据
title_secondary: Can We Build More Effective Place-Based Policies? Theory and Evidence
authors: Matthew Freedman, David Neumark
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Amid renewed policy interest, the academic literature on place-based programs has expanded dramatically in recent years. In this essay, we review recent theoretical and empirical work in an effort to assess when and why place-based job creation policies succeed or fail. Drawing on theory, we describe key dimensions on which place-based programs vary and discuss evidence on the consequences of different design choices. We conclude with several lessons for the next generation of place-based programs.
abstract_zh: 随着政策关注度的再度升温，近年来关于区域导向型项目的学术文献显著增加。本文旨在回顾近期理论与实证研究，以评估区域导向型就业创造政策在何种条件下及为何能成功或失败。基于理论，我们阐述了区域导向型项目在关键维度上的差异，并讨论了不同设计选择所带来的后果证据。最后，我们为下一代区域导向型项目总结了几点经验教训。

title: Air pollution and conflict in West Africa: The effects of the harmattan dust
title_zh: 西非空气污染与冲突：哈马丹沙尘的影响
title_primary: 西非空气污染与冲突：哈马丹沙尘的影响
title_secondary: Air pollution and conflict in West Africa: The effects of the harmattan dust
authors: A. Delgerchuluun, K. Kis-Katos, K. Perlik
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of dust-driven pollution on social conflict in West Africa, exploiting exogenous variation in PM2.5 concentrations caused by Saharan dust transported by Harmattan winds. Using a monthly panel covering 16 West African countries from 2003 to 2017, we combine satellite-derived PM2.5 data with geo-referenced conflict events. We instrument PM2.5 using dust emissions from the Bodélé Depression interacted with northeasterly Harmattan winds. We find that a one standard deviation increase in PM2.5 reduces the likelihood of conflict by 0.13 percentage points. The effects are concentrated in riots, one-sided violence, ethnic and religious conflict, and conflicts involving non-local actors. Similarly, we find that resource-related conflicts increase. The findings suggest that severe dust episodes constrain mobility, visibility, and social interaction, thereby reducing opportunities for violent confrontation, even as they intensify competition over scarce resources.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了沙尘驱动的污染对西非社会冲突的影响，利用由哈马丹风输送的撒哈拉沙尘引起的PM2.5浓度外生变化。通过覆盖2003年至2017年16个西非国家的月度面板数据，我们将卫星获取的PM2.5数据与地理参照的冲突事件相结合。我们使用博德莱洼地的沙尘排放与东北哈马丹风的交互作用作为PM2.5的工具变量。研究发现，PM2.5每增加一个标准差，冲突发生的可能性降低0.13个百分点。这一效应主要集中在骚乱、单方面暴力、民族和宗教冲突以及涉及非本地行为者的冲突中。同样，我们发现资源相关冲突有所增加。研究结果表明，严重的沙尘事件限制了流动性、能见度和社交互动，从而减少了暴力对抗的机会，即便它们加剧了对稀缺资源的竞争。

title: Selection into Medicine
title_zh: 医学专业的选拔机制
title_primary: 医学专业的选拔机制
title_secondary: Selection into Medicine
authors: Diane E. Alexander, Molly Schnell
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how selection into medicine in the United States influences physician practice styles. We exploit macroeconomic conditions at the time of medical school application as an exogenous shock to the applicant pool and find that labor market downturns in other prestigious fields increase applications to medical school and shift the composition of matriculating cohorts toward students from non–pre-medical backgrounds. Strikingly, these low–outside-option cohorts practice medicine differently decades later. Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国医学专业选择如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时的宏观经济状况作为申请者群体的外生冲击，发现其他声望较高领域的劳动力市场衰退会增加医学院的申请人数，并使入学群体的构成向非医学预科背景的学生倾斜。引人注目的是，这些外部选择较差的群体在数十年后的执业方式有所不同。在控制经验、专业和结果年份的条件下，经济衰退时期的医生尽管面对更健康的患者，却对每位受益人的医疗保险账单更高——尤其是在可自由支配、创收性服务上——并倾向于选择财务激励更强的执业环境。额外支出并未带来可检测的患者健康改善。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，当外部选择较弱时，被吸引进入医学领域的人具有更强的财务动机，并暗示医学院招生在最终塑造医生执业方式的特质筛选上并不完美。

title: Algorithm-Driven SVARs: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
title_zh: 算法驱动的SVAR模型：大数据荒野中的导航
title_primary: 算法驱动的SVAR模型：大数据荒野中的导航
title_secondary: Algorithm-Driven SVARs: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
authors: Yucheng Yang, Tao Zha
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Every SVAR result is conditional on two choices: the restrictions that identify the shock and the variables on which they operate. The literature disciplines the first; the second is chosen by hand. We develop a Bayesian methodology that constructs information sets, uses an out-of-sample criterion, and retains the largest system it admits. Under recursive identification, output rises with housing production rather than household credit alone. For monetary policy, an anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR with multiple instruments strengthens the credit spread channel. A core system augmented with the selected corporate spread identifies expected default risk as a potent transmission margin.
abstract_zh: 每一个SVAR结果都依赖于两个选择：识别冲击的约束条件及其作用变量。现有文献对前者进行了规范，而后者则靠人工选择。我们开发了一种贝叶斯方法，构建信息集，采用样本外准则，并保留其允许的最大系统。在递归识别下，产出随住房生产而非仅家庭信贷上升。对于货币政策，一个无锚点的联合贝叶斯代理SVAR，结合多种工具，强化了信用利差渠道。一个核心系统，辅以选定的企业利差，识别出预期违约风险作为有力的传导边际。

title: Group Consulting Continues to Benefit Firms after a Decade: Experimental Evidence from Colombian Auto Parts Firms
title_zh: 十年后集团咨询仍使企业受益：来自哥伦比亚汽车零部件企业的实验证据
title_primary: 十年后集团咨询仍使企业受益：来自哥伦比亚汽车零部件企业的实验证据
title_secondary: Group Consulting Continues to Benefit Firms after a Decade: Experimental Evidence from Colombian Auto Parts Firms
authors: Iacovone, Leonardo, McKenzie, David, Maloney, William
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We revisit a randomized experiment that demonstrated the cost-effectiveness of group-based, compared to individual, consulting services for firms in the Colombian auto parts industry using administrative data that now permits following firms for up to a decade. Firms in the group consulting intervention are more likely to survive, have higher employment, and have increased sales and profits by approximately 50%. This longer-term growth appears to in part come through increased exporting, as well as persistent management improvements. Case studies offer insights into underlying mechanisms. The more expensive individual consulting has noisy long-term impacts that are much less cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了一项随机实验，该实验通过行政数据展示了哥伦比亚汽车零部件行业中，相较于个体咨询，团体咨询对企业服务的成本效益，如今这些数据允许对企业进行长达十年的追踪。参与团体咨询干预的企业更有可能存活，就业人数更高，销售额和利润约增长50%。这种长期增长部分似乎源于出口增加，以及持续的管理改进。案例研究揭示了背后的机制。成本更高的个体咨询在长期影响上存在噪音，且成本效益远低于团体咨询。

title: Nonlinear dynamics of higher education participation under social influence and endogenous returns
title_zh: 社会影响与内生回报下高等教育参与的非线性动态
title_primary: 社会影响与内生回报下高等教育参与的非线性动态
title_secondary: Nonlinear dynamics of higher education participation under social influence and endogenous returns
authors: Andrea Caravaggio, Marco Catola, Silvia Leoni
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Decisions to pursue higher education are shaped by economic incentives, peer effects, and expectations about future returns. This paper develops a non-linear dynamic model of educational participation for study fields in which the motivations to enrol are heterogeneous and cannot be reduced to a single driver. Agents allocate resources between education and consumption while their preferences evolve endogenously. Followers are reinforced by aggregate participation, while Positional Agents respond to social distinctiveness and to an endogenous wage premium that declines with the supply of educated workers. We show that the interaction between imitation, positional concerns, and labour-market feedback can generate endogenous cycles and irregular dynamics, especially for intermediate mixtures of behavioural types. Allowing population shares to evolve adds a further source of instability through switching between behavioural rules. Finally, policy interventions are not necessarily stabilizing: counter-cyclical cost subsidies may discipline enrolment, whereas strong behavioural signalling can amplify imitative responses and generate overreaction.
abstract_zh: 追求高等教育的决策受到经济激励、同伴效应及对未来回报预期的影响。本文针对学习领域构建了一个非线性动态教育参与模型，其中入学动机具有异质性，无法归结为单一驱动因素。行为主体在资源分配上兼顾教育与消费，而其偏好则内生演化。追随者受总体参与度强化，而地位追求者则对社会独特性及随受教育劳动力供给增加而下降的内生工资溢价作出反应。我们表明，模仿行为、地位关注与劳动力市场反馈之间的相互作用可产生内生周期及不规则动态，尤其在行为类型中等混合比例时更为显著。允许人口份额演化，通过行为规则间的切换进一步引入不稳定来源。最后，政策干预未必具有稳定作用：逆周期成本补贴可能约束入学，而强烈的行为信号则可能放大模仿反应并引发过度反应。

title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: 分阶段准入与双重用途人工智能的责任
title_primary: 分阶段准入与双重用途人工智能的责任
title_secondary: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
authors: Joshua S. Gans
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How should regulators combine staged access to a dual-use AI model with developer liability? I model a defender and an adversary searching for the same software flaws. After release, liability induces more defensive search but also makes the adversary search harder, limiting its effect on harm. Exclusive access removes this strategic response, so staged access and liability are complements in protection. Defensive effort rises towards the release date, making additional delay progressively less productive. Optimal evaluation windows are therefore bounded, and their response to greater harm saturates. Because defensive search uses real resources, the efficient liability rate can be below full internalisation of harm. That rate generally cannot induce the developer to choose the regulator's preferred release date, leaving a distinct role for a timing mandate.
abstract_zh: 监管者应如何将双用途AI模型的分阶段访问与开发者责任相结合？我构建了一个防御者与对手同时搜寻相同软件漏洞的模型。发布后，责任机制虽能激励更多防御性搜寻，但也会促使对手加大搜寻力度，从而削弱其对损害的限制作用。独占访问消除了这一策略性反应，因此分阶段访问与责任在防护上具有互补性。防御性努力随发布日期的临近而增加，使得额外延迟的生产力逐渐递减。因此，最优评估窗口是有界的，其对更大损害的反应趋于饱和。由于防御性搜寻消耗实际资源，有效责任率可低于损害的完全内部化水平。该比率通常无法诱导开发者选择监管者偏好的发布日期，这为时间指令留下了独特的作用空间。

title: DP19898 Race-Related Research in Economics
title_zh: 经济学中的种族相关研究
title_primary: 经济学中的种族相关研究
title_secondary: DP19898 Race-Related Research in Economics
authors: Arun Advani, Elliott Ash, Anton Boltachka, David Cai, Imran Rasul
official: 官方在线 2025-01-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Issues of racial justice and economic inequalities between racial and ethnic groups have risen to the top of public debate. Economists' ability to contribute to these debates is based on the body of race-related research. We study the volume and content of race-related research in economics. We base our analysis on a corpus of 225,000 economics publications from 1960 to 2020 to which we apply an algorithmic approach to classify race-related work. We present three new facts. First, since 1960 less than 2% of economics publications have been race-related. There is an uptick in such work in the mid 1990s. Among the top-5 journals this is driven by the American Economic Review, Quarterly Journal of Economics and the Journal of Political Economy. Econometrica and the Review of Economic Studies have each cumulatively published fewer than 15 race-related articles since 1960. Second, on content, while over 50% of race-related publications in the 1970s focused on Black individuals, by the 2010s this had fallen to 20%. There has been a steady decline in the share of race-related research on discrimination since the 1980s, with a rise in the share of studies on identity. Finally, we apply our algorithm to NBER and CEPR working papers posted over the last four decades, to study an earlier stage of the research process. We document a balkanization of race-related research into a few fields, and its continued absence from many others -- a result that holds even within the subset of research examining issues of inequality or diversity. We discuss implications of our findings for economists' ability to contribute to debates on race and ethnicity in the economy.
abstract_zh: 种族正义以及种族与族裔群体之间的经济不平等问题已升至公共辩论的首要议题。经济学家能否为这些辩论作出贡献，取决于与种族相关的研究成果。我们研究了经济学中种族相关研究的数量与内容。我们的分析基于1960年至2020年间225,000篇经济学出版物的语料库，并采用算法方法对种族相关工作进行分类。我们提出了三个新事实。首先，自1960年以来，经济学出版物中种族相关的比例不足2%。此类工作在1990年代中期有所增加。在五大顶级期刊中，这一增长主要由《美国经济评论》、《经济学季刊》和《政治经济学杂志》推动。《计量经济学》和《经济研究评论》自1960年以来累计发表的种族相关文章均不足15篇。其次，在内容方面，尽管1970年代超过50%的种族相关出版物聚焦于黑人个体，但到2010年代这一比例已降至20%。自1980年代以来，种族相关研究中关于歧视的研究份额持续下降，而关于身份认同的研究份额则有所上升。最后，我们将算法应用于过去四十年间NBER和CEPR发布的工作论文，以研究研究过程的早期阶段。我们记录了种族相关研究在少数几个领域的割裂现象，以及其在许多其他领域的持续缺失——即便在考察不平等或多样性问题的研究子集中，这一结果依然成立。我们讨论了我们的发现对经济学家参与经济中种族与族裔议题辩论能力的启示。

title: Fool's Gold? How the US Dollar Lost its Shine
title_zh: 愚人金？美元如何失去光泽
title_primary: 愚人金？美元如何失去光泽
title_secondary: Fool's Gold? How the US Dollar Lost its Shine
authors: Kai Arvai, Nuno Coimbra, Marco Pinchetti
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of international investors' portfolio choices between gold and sovereign bonds in an environment shaped by economic and geopolitical shocks. We develop an endogenous portfolio choice model where reserve safety has a political dimension — sovereign bonds issued by the dominant reserve country are more liquid but exposed to the issuer's sanctions authority, while gold offers sanctions protection at the cost of lower liquidity. Our model implies that US convenience yields fall during periods of high sanction risk, as safe-asset demand fragments along geopolitical lines. Empirically, periods of elevated geopolitical risk coincide with higher gold prices and 10-year Treasury yields. In such periods, the average composition of official reserves shifts toward gold, with countries less aligned with the US in UN voting patterns increasing their holdings by a greater extent.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在经济与地缘政治冲击环境下，国际投资者在黄金与主权债券之间进行投资组合选择的决定因素。我们构建了一个内生投资组合选择模型，其中储备安全性具有政治维度——由主导储备国发行的主权债券流动性更高，但面临发行国制裁权力的风险；而黄金则提供制裁保护，但流动性较低。模型表明，在制裁风险高企时期，美国便利收益率下降，因为安全资产需求沿地缘政治界限分化。实证结果显示，地缘政治风险上升时期与黄金价格上涨及10年期国债收益率上升同时出现。在此类时期，官方储备的平均构成向黄金倾斜，其中在联合国投票模式中与美国立场不一致的国家增持黄金的幅度更大。

title: Impact of reverse rural-urban migration on farmland transfer: Empirical evidence from the China Family Panel Studies
title_zh: 逆城乡迁移对农地流转的影响：基于中国家庭追踪调查的实证证据
title_primary: 逆城乡迁移对农地流转的影响：基于中国家庭追踪调查的实证证据
title_secondary: Impact of reverse rural-urban migration on farmland transfer: Empirical evidence from the China Family Panel Studies
authors: Qianlong Yang, Yuanyuan Zhu, Yilin Gan, Zhenfa Tu, Jiaxing Cui
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The mobility of rural agricultural labor is critical for the efficient allocation of farmland resources. Earlier studies have primarily focused on the impact of rural out-migration on farmland transfer. However, reverse rural-urban migration (RRUM), as an integral component of bidirectional urban-rural factor flows, has received comparatively limited scholarly attention. Therefore, this study draws on data from four waves of the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) and employs Probit models to examine the effects of RRUM on farmland transfer. It also investigates whether household income and regional consumption moderate these effects. The results indicate that RRUM significantly promotes farmland transfer-in but does not exert a statistically significant impact on farmland transfer-out. The observed spatial heterogeneity indicates that RRUM has a stronger positive effect on farmland transfer-in in Eastern and Central China, while its impact on promoting farmland transfer-out is more pronounced in Northeastern and Western China. Moreover, households headed by older farmers are more inclined to transfer-in farmland. Moderation analysis further shows that household economic status negatively moderates the effect of RRUM on farmland transfer-in, whereas regional consumption expenditure negatively moderates its impact on both farmland transfer-in and transfer-out. RRUM has a significant positive effect on whether farmers pay rent after farmland transfer-in, but no significant impact on their likelihood of collecting rent after farmland transfer-out. The generalized linear model (GLM) results further suggest that RRUM has no significant effect on either rent payment or rent collection by farmers. These findings provide empirical evidence of the dynamics of farmland transfer in China under bidirectional urban-rural factor flows and offer guidance for designing region-specific farmland-transfer policies that promote global sustainable agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 农村农业劳动力的流动性对于 farmland 资源的高效配置至关重要。早期研究主要聚焦于农村劳动力外流对 farmland 流转的影响。然而，作为城乡双向要素流动不可或缺的一部分，逆向城乡迁移（RRUM）受到的学术关注相对有限。因此，本研究利用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）四轮数据，采用Probit模型考察RRUM对farmland流转的影响，并进一步探究家庭收入和区域消费是否在其中起到调节作用。结果表明，RRUM显著促进了farmland转入，但对farmland转出未产生统计上显著的影响。观察到的空间异质性显示，在东部和中部地区，RRUM对farmland转入的正向效应更强，而在东北和西部地区，其对促进farmland转出的作用更为明显。此外，户主年龄较大的家庭更倾向于转入farmland。调节分析进一步表明，家庭经济状况对RRUM促进farmland转入的效果具有负向调节作用，而区域消费支出则对RRUM影响farmland转入和转出均产生负向调节效应。RRUM对农户在farmland转入后支付租金的行为有显著正向影响，但对farmland转出后收取租金的可能性无显著影响。广义线性模型（GLM）结果进一步显示，RRUM对农户支付或收取租金均无显著效应。这些发现为城乡双向要素流动背景下中国farmland流转的动态提供了经验证据，并为制定区域差异化的farmland流转政策、促进全球可持续农业发展提供了指导。

title: Excessive Pharmaceutical Marketing Expenditure: Policy Remedies from China
title_zh: 过高的药品营销支出：来自中国的政策应对

title_secondary: Excessive Pharmaceutical Marketing Expenditure: Policy Remedies from China
authors: Chenyuan Liu, Yi Lu, Wanyu Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Developing countries face high pharmaceutical prices despite the presence of multiple generic producers. One key reason is excessive spending on sales and marketing by drug firms. This paper examines how centralized drug procurement can curb such marketing efforts and reduce prices, using a policy experiment in China where certain generics are procured through centralized auctions in pilot cities. Winning firms gain large market shares directly without high marketing costs. We find that the centralized auction significantly reduces both sales costs and prices, with winning firms experiencing notable decreases in marketing-related labor demand.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家尽管存在多家仿制药生产商，却仍面临高昂的药品价格。其中一个关键原因是制药企业在销售和营销上的过度支出。本文利用中国在试点城市对特定仿制药实施集中采购拍卖的政策实验，考察集中采购如何抑制此类营销行为并降低价格。中标企业无需承担高额营销成本即可直接获得较大市场份额。研究发现，集中采购拍卖显著降低了销售成本与药品价格，中标企业的营销相关劳动力需求出现明显下降。

title: Horizontal directors and investment efficiency
title_zh: 横向董事与投资效率
title_primary: 横向董事与投资效率
title_secondary: Horizontal directors and investment efficiency
authors: José-Miguel Gaspar, Sumingyue Wang, Liang Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Horizontal directors, board members who also hold board seats in same-industry peers, are common in U.S. corporations. We posit that horizontal directorships can enhance the efficiency of corporate investment decisions. Horizontal directors enjoy access to current information flows, which help boards fulfill their roles of advising and monitoring – a form of learning from peers. We find that horizontal directorships are negatively related to investment inefficiency, and with over-investment in particular. Exogenous shocks to board composition provide a causal interpretation to our findings. Our paper contributes to a nuanced view of horizontal directors by highlighting their contribution to mitigate excessive investment.
abstract_zh: 横向董事，即同时在同行业其他公司担任董事的董事会成员，在美国企业中普遍存在。我们假设横向董事职位能够提升企业投资决策的效率。横向董事能够获取当前的信息流，这有助于董事会履行其咨询与监督职能——这是一种向同行学习的形式。我们发现横向董事职位与投资无效率呈负相关，尤其是与过度投资的关系更为显著。董事会构成的外生冲击为我们的发现提供了因果解释。本文通过强调横向董事在缓解过度投资方面的贡献，为理解横向董事的作用提供了细致视角。

title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
title_zh: 检测正在展开的关键节点：基于120年报道的基础、测量与应用
title_primary: 检测正在展开的关键节点：基于120年报道的基础、测量与应用
title_secondary: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
authors: Michael Callen, Gregory Levy, Saipremnath Muthukumaran, Jonathan Weigel, Noam Yuchtman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how --- and when --- institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive--11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019--while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s--a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
abstract_zh: 解释为何一些国家走向富裕而另一些国家却陷入贫困，需要理解制度如何——以及何时——发生变迁。大量研究认为，制度变迁往往发生在关键节点：即多种制度未来可能并存（包括回归现状）的时刻。然而，多数实证研究仅以回溯方式考察关键节点，这可能导致遗漏制度处于变动中却最终未发生改变的关键时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，用于实时检测正在展开的关键节点。核心洞见在于将关键节点理解为制度不确定性时期——这为文本分类器提供了具有理论依据的检测对象，使其能在同期话语中识别此类时刻。本章中，我们运用这一理念研究历史关键节点，以报纸文本作为反映当时制度不确定性认知的丰富信息源。通过训练基于大语言模型的分类器，我们将这一洞见转化为测量策略，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案库（涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章），同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年间的120年报道。由此产生了首个基于关键节点概念、以文本为基础的长期制度不确定性度量指标。相较于既有的地缘政治与经济风险指数，本指标在多个方面实现创新：（i）即便在未发生正式制度变迁的时期，也能捕捉到高度不确定性，这与关键节点的事前定义一致；（ii）能更早预警重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）；（iii）采用统一的事前度量标准评估候选关键节点；（iv）为研究关键节点如何塑造制度与长期发展开辟新路径。当前，基于《泰晤士报》的指数显示，美英两国的制度不确定性已升至与20世纪40年代初相当的水平——这一信号被其他主流风险指标所遗漏。

title: Commitment and threats in adversarial bargaining: Insights from a plea bargaining experiment
title_zh: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示
title_primary: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示

authors: Pablo Cuellar, Lucas Rentschler
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
abstract_zh: 本文研究承诺能力如何影响对抗性谈判中的威胁。在此类情境中，提议方（检察官）向回应方（被告）提出要求，并以要求遭拒后发生冲突作为威胁。本文聚焦辩诉交易：检察官在谈判前先对被告提出指控；若双方未达成协议，案件进入审判，指控将影响双方收益。检察官在审判中的预期收益在较低指控水平达到最大，而使被告损失最大化的指控水平更高。审判开始前，检察官可依据其承诺能力，在一定范围内降低指控。实验数据显示，具备足够承诺能力的参与者会通过提出过高指控来增强谈判能力，但其行为比理论预测更为保守。

title: Beyond determinism: Accounting for weather variability in the carbon pricing debate for EU agriculture
title_zh: 超越决定论：欧盟农业碳定价辩论中天气变率的考量

authors: Davit Stepanyan, Sebastian Neuenfeldt, Alisa Spiegel, Mareike Söder, Julio G Fournier Gabela 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agriculture accounts for 11 per cent of EU greenhouse gas emissions, yet sectoral emissions have stagnated over the past two decades. This paper evaluates carbon pricing in EU agriculture by integrating stochastic yield variability into the CAPRI model. We assess how different carbon price levels affect emissions and outcome uncertainty. Results show that carbon pricing reduces emissions, and higher price levels are associated with lower uncertainty in policy outcomes. While expected results remain similar to deterministic simulations, stochastic modeling reveals greater regional and sectoral heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for production risk when designing agricultural climate policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要农业占欧盟温室气体排放的11%，但过去二十年间该行业排放量停滞不前。本文通过将随机产量波动性纳入CAPRI模型，评估了欧盟农业中的碳定价机制。我们分析了不同碳价水平对排放量和结果不确定性的影响。结果表明，碳定价能够减少排放，且更高的碳价水平与政策结果不确定性的降低相关。尽管预期结果与确定性模拟相似，但随机建模揭示了更大的区域和行业异质性。这些发现强调了在设计农业气候政策时考虑生产风险的重要性。

title: Heterogeneous Inflation Volatility in Production Networks: Producer vs. Consumer Prices
title_zh: 生产网络中的异质性通胀波动：生产者价格与消费者价格
title_primary: 生产网络中的异质性通胀波动：生产者价格与消费者价格

source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

abstract: We investigate the sources of heterogeneity in producer and consumer price inflation rates at both industry and aggregate levels. To this end, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with a production network, which enables us to disentangle the effects of producer price stickiness and consumer price stickiness in the transmission of sectoral shocks—a distinction often overlooked in theoretical models. We demonstrate that sectoral cost-push shocks and network connectivity are key determinants of the relative volatility between producer and consumer price inflation in the U.S. Furthermore, we quantify how these shocks propagate through cascading adjustments in producer prices, ultimately influencing the aggregate consumer price.
abstract_zh: 我们探究了行业及总体层面上生产者与消费者价格通胀率异质性的来源。为此，我们构建了一个包含生产网络的动态一般均衡模型，该模型使我们能够区分生产者价格粘性与消费者价格粘性在部门冲击传导中的作用——这一区别在理论模型中常被忽视。我们证明，部门成本推动冲击和网络连通性是决定美国生产者与消费者价格通胀相对波动性的关键因素。此外，我们量化了这些冲击如何通过生产者价格的级联调整进行传播，最终影响总体消费者价格。

title: How Do Financial and Longevity Literacy Affect Annuity Demand?
title_zh: 金融素养与长寿素养如何影响年金需求？
title_primary: 金融素养与长寿素养如何影响年金需求？
title_secondary: How Do Financial and Longevity Literacy Affect Annuity Demand?
authors: Jeffrey R. Brown
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Deciding whether to use an annuity to draw down accumulated retirement wealth is among the most complex financial decisions individuals face. It requires reasoning about longevity risk, stochastic income streams, and largely irreversible tradeoffs, often at older ages and with limited opportunities to learn from experience. This paper reviews theoretical, empirical, and experimental research to examine how financial literacy and longevity literacy shape annuitization decisions. While some extensions of the standard lifecycle model can rationalize low annuity demand, their explanatory power depends on individuals’ ability to optimize over a set of complex risks and tradeoffs. Evidence shows that, although financial and longevity literacy are only weakly and inconsistently related to annuity take-up, they are strongly associated with retirement planning, the coherence of annuity valuations, and sensitivity to framing and choice architecture. These patterns suggest that literacy should be understood not as a direct determinant of annuity demand, but as a constraint on the extent to which observed annuitization behavior can be interpreted as revealing true preferences.
abstract_zh: 决定是否使用年金来提取积累的退休财富，是个人面临的最复杂的财务决策之一。这需要考量长寿风险、随机收入流以及很大程度上不可逆的权衡取舍，且往往发生在年长阶段，同时从经验中学习的机会有限。本文回顾了理论、实证与实验研究，探讨金融素养和长寿素养如何影响年金化决策。尽管标准生命周期模型的某些扩展可以解释较低的年金需求，但其解释力取决于个人在一系列复杂风险与权衡中优化决策的能力。证据表明，尽管金融素养和长寿素养与年金参与率之间仅存在微弱且不一致的关联，但它们与退休规划、年金估值的连贯性以及对框架和选择架构的敏感性密切相关。这些模式表明，素养不应被理解为年金需求的直接决定因素，而应被视为一种约束条件，制约着观察到的年金化行为在多大程度上可以被解读为揭示真实偏好。

title: 退休与家庭财务脆弱性：理论与经验分析
title_zh: 退休与家庭财务脆弱性：理论与经验分析
title_primary: 退休与家庭财务脆弱性：理论与经验分析
authors: 尹志超, 栗传政, 沈吉, 吴夕
official: 官方发布 2026-06-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 随着我国人口老龄化程度不断深化,老年群体的家庭财务状况受到广泛关注。本文构建了一个生命周期模型,分析退休对家庭消费和资产配置的影响,为理解退休与家庭财务脆弱性之间的因果关系提供了一个结构化的分析视角。在此基础上,模糊断点回归分析表明,退休会显著增加家庭的财务脆弱性,不同形式的稳健性检验均支持这一结论。进一步分析发现,退休使家庭收入大于预期支出的概率显著上升,使家庭流动性资产小于非预期支出的概率显著上升。异质性分析显示,退休对低人力资本、低社会资本、低物质资本和高健康风险家庭的财务脆弱性影响更大。本文为全面认识家庭财务脆弱性提供了新的视角,为老龄化背景下相关政策的制定提供了参考依据。
abstract_zh: 随着我国人口老龄化程度不断深化，老年群体的家庭财务状况受到广泛关注。本文构建了一个生命周期模型，分析退休对家庭消费和资产配置的影响，为理解退休与家庭财务脆弱性之间的因果关系提供了一个结构化的分析视角。在此基础上，模糊断点回归分析表明，退休会显著增加家庭的财务脆弱性，不同形式的稳健性检验均支持这一结论。进一步分析发现，退休使家庭收入大于预期支出的概率显著上升，使家庭流动性资产小于非预期支出的概率显著...

title: Mergers, Foreign Competition, and Jobs: Evidence from the US Appliance Industry
title_zh: 并购、外国竞争与就业：来自美国家电行业的证据
title_primary: 并购、外国竞争与就业：来自美国家电行业的证据
title_secondary: Mergers, Foreign Competition, and Jobs: Evidence from the US Appliance Industry
authors: Felix Montag
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Policy choices often create trade-offs between workers and consumers. I examine how foreign competition alters the consumer welfare and domestic employment effects of mergers. I construct a model incorporating consumer demand, endogenous product portfolios, and employment decisions. Applying the model to Whirlpool’s acquisition of Maytag in the appliance industry, I compare the observed merger to a counterfactual acquisition by a foreign buyer. Although Whirlpool’s acquisition decreased consumer welfare by $271 million annually, it preserved 797 domestic jobs. These jobs must therefore be valued at more than $344, 000 per year for the domestic employment benefits to offset the consumer harm. (JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
abstract_zh: 政策选择往往在工人与消费者之间产生权衡。本文考察了外国竞争如何改变并购对消费者福利和国内就业的影响。我构建了一个包含消费者需求、内生产品组合和就业决策的模型。将该模型应用于家电行业惠而浦对美泰克的收购案例，我将实际发生的并购与外国买家收购的反事实情景进行了比较。尽管惠而浦的收购每年使消费者福利减少2.71亿美元，但保留了797个国内就业岗位。因此，要使国内就业收益抵消消费者损失，这些岗位的年价值必须超过34.4万美元。(JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)

title: Unpacking trend inflation: Evidence from a factor correlated unobserved components model of sticky and flexible prices
title_zh: 解构趋势通胀：来自粘性与弹性价格因子相关不可观测成分模型的证据
title_primary: 解构趋势通胀：来自粘性与弹性价格因子相关不可观测成分模型的证据
title_secondary: Unpacking trend inflation: Evidence from a factor correlated unobserved components model of sticky and flexible prices
authors: Mengheng Li, Ivan Mendieta-Muñoz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a factor correlated unobserved components (FCUC) model to analyze the sticky and flexible components of U.S. inflation. The proposed FCUC framework estimates trend inflation and component cycles in a flexible stochastic environment with time-varying volatility, factor loadings, and cross-frequency (trend-cycle) correlations, thus capturing how structural heterogeneity in price adjustment shapes the evolution of aggregate trend inflation over time. Using Bayesian estimation methods, we show that the FCUC model substantially reduces the uncertainty surrounding estimates of trend inflation and improves both point and density forecast accuracy. Our findings reveal that, particularly following the Global Financial Crisis and more markedly since the COVID-19 recession, transitory price shocks originating from flexible inflation have become a major driver of trend inflation, while sticky inflation explains only part of the variation. These results indicate that temporary price movements can have persistent effects, highlighting important policy implications regarding the cyclical dynamics of disaggregated inflation components amid evolving macroeconomic conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个因子相关不可观测成分（FCUC）模型，用以分析美国通胀中的粘性与弹性成分。所提出的FCUC框架在具有时变波动性、因子载荷及跨频率（趋势-周期）相关性的灵活随机环境中，估计趋势通胀与成分周期，从而捕捉价格调整中的结构性异质性如何随时间塑造总体趋势通胀的演变。利用贝叶斯估计方法，我们表明FCUC模型显著降低了围绕趋势通胀估计的不确定性，并提高了点预测与密度预测的准确性。我们的发现揭示，特别是在全球金融危机之后，以及自新冠疫情衰退以来更为显著，源自弹性通胀的暂时性价格冲击已成为趋势通胀的主要驱动因素，而粘性通胀仅解释了部分变动。这些结果表明，暂时性价格变动可能产生持久影响，突显了在不断演变的宏观经济条件下，关于分类通胀成分周期动态的重要政策含义。

title: Gender equality through turnover: Quasi-experimental evidence from term limit reforms in Italy
title_zh: 通过人员更替实现性别平等：来自意大利任期限制改革的准实验证据
title_primary: 通过人员更替实现性别平等：来自意大利任期限制改革的准实验证据
title_secondary: Gender equality through turnover: Quasi-experimental evidence from term limit reforms in Italy
authors: Carolina Kansikas, Manuel Bagues
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether term limits can accelerate women’s access to top political positions by analyzing two reforms in Italian local elections that extended mayoral term limits from two to three five-year terms. In a period marked by rapid growth in women’s political participation, the first reform affected municipalities with fewer than 3000 inhabitants in 2014, and the second those below 5000 in 2022. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, we find that longer term limits restrict opportunities for early-career politicians, with substantial effects on female representation: the share of female mayors would be 8 percentage points higher without the term limit extensions. The impact is larger in municipalities with more women in lower political positions and where gender quotas for council members are present, suggesting that entry-level quotas can be more effective when paired with policies promoting turnover in top positions. • Italy extended mayoral term limits below population thresholds in 2014 and 2022. • We use a difference-in-discontinuities design at the 3000 and 5000 cutoffs. • Without the reforms, the share of female mayors would be 8 p.p. higher. • The effect operates through incumbent retention, not gender preferences for tenure. • Term limits complement entry-level gender quotas in promoting female representation.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析意大利地方选举中的两项改革来研究任期限制能否加速女性获得最高政治职位的机会，这两项改革将市长任期限制从两届延长至三届五年任期。在一个女性政治参与迅速增长的时代，第一项改革于2014年影响了居民少于3000人的市镇，第二项改革于2022年影响了居民少于5000人的市镇。利用断点回归中的差异设计，我们发现更长的任期限制限制了早期职业政治家的机会，对女性代表产生了显著影响：如果没有延长任期限制，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。这种影响在女性在较低政治职位中占比较多以及存在市议会成员性别配额的市镇中更为显著，这表明入门级配额在配合促进高层职位轮换的政策时可能更为有效。• 意大利在2014年和2022年按人口阈值延长了市长任期限制。• 我们使用3000和5000人口截断点的差异断点回归设计。• 如果没有改革，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。• 这种效应通过现任者留任发挥作用，而非性别对任期的偏好。• 任期限制与入门级性别配额相辅相成，共同促进女性代表。

title: Lobbying under conflicting interests
title_zh: 利益冲突下的游说行为
title_primary: 利益冲突下的游说行为
title_secondary: Lobbying under conflicting interests
authors: Artyom Jelnov, Doron Klunover
official: 官方在线 2026-04-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A variation of a cheap talk game is considered in which the preferences of a special interest group conflict with those of a policymaker if she is benevolent; however, she may be corrupt. The interest group, which knows the state of the world, sends a message to the policymaker and may also exert costly lobbying effort for its preferred policy to be adopted. We show that expected welfare, which is the same in all PBE, is decreasing in the probability that the policymaker is corrupt. Surprisingly, it decreases faster when this probability is above one-half, suggesting that corrupt behavior will be tolerated only up to a certain level.
abstract_zh: 本文考虑了一种廉价交谈博弈的变体，其中特殊利益集团的偏好与政策制定者（若其廉洁）的偏好相冲突；然而，该政策制定者可能腐败。利益集团知晓世界状态，向政策制定者发送信息，并可能为其偏好的政策被采纳而付出代价高昂的游说努力。我们表明，在所有完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）中相同的预期福利，随政策制定者腐败概率的增加而递减。令人惊讶的是，当这一概率超过二分之一时，福利下降得更快，这表明腐败行为仅在达到一定水平之前才会被容忍。

title: Evaluating University Graduates: Prestige Versus Merit
title_zh: 评估大学毕业生：声望与能力
title_primary: 评估大学毕业生：声望与能力
title_secondary: Evaluating University Graduates: Prestige Versus Merit
authors: Raphael Boleslavsky, Cheng Li
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a game in which universities compete by making unobservable investments in education quality. Subsequently, the graduates are considered for a single placement by an organization. A merit-based evaluator compares the realized skill of each graduate. A prestige-based evaluator only observes a noisy signal of the universities' relative education quality. Though a prestige-based evaluator does not know the true skills of the graduates, we derive conditions under which an increase in the probability of the prestige-based evaluator incentivizes higher investment and benefits the organization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个博弈模型，其中大学通过进行不可观测的教育质量投资来竞争。随后，毕业生被一个组织考虑进行单一职位安置。基于能力的评估者会比较每位毕业生实际展现的技能。而基于声望的评估者仅能观察到大学相对教育质量的噪声信号。尽管基于声望的评估者不了解毕业生的真实技能，我们推导出条件，在这些条件下，增加基于声望评估者的概率会激励更高的投资，并使组织受益。

title: Employers’ Language Proficiency Requirements and Hiring of Immigrants
title_zh: 雇主语言能力要求与移民雇佣
title_primary: 雇主语言能力要求与移民雇佣
title_secondary: Employers’ Language Proficiency Requirements and Hiring of Immigrants
authors: Magnus Carlsson, Stefan Eriksson, Dan-Olof Rooth, Tímea Laura Molnár
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Labor markets in advanced economies have undergone substantial change due to globalization, technological improvements, and organizational changes, making language proficiency increasingly important even in less skilled jobs. Has this development led employers to shy away from hiring immigrants with limited host-country language skills? We shed light on this question by conducting a large-scale field experiment, where we introduce common second-language features in immigrants’ resumes. We also conduct employer surveys to interpret our experimental results. Our main finding is that language proficiency has a strong positive effect on being invited to a job interview, even in typical immigrant entry jobs.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发达经济体的劳动力市场因全球化、技术进步和组织变革而经历了重大变化，使得语言能力即使在技能要求较低的岗位中也日益重要。这一发展是否导致雇主回避雇佣东道国语言能力有限的移民？我们通过开展大规模实地实验来探讨此问题，在实验中我们在移民简历中引入了常见的第二语言特征。同时，我们还进行了雇主调查以解读实验结果。我们的主要发现是，语言能力对获得面试邀请具有显著的正向影响，即使在典型的移民入门级工作中也是如此。

title: Interpreting the United States Consumer Price Index using index mining techniques and its component price indices: 2012 to 2023
title_zh: 运用指数挖掘技术及其成分价格指数解读美国消费者价格指数：2012年至2023年
title_primary: 运用指数挖掘技术及其成分价格指数解读美国消费者价格指数：2012年至2023年
title_secondary: Interpreting the United States Consumer Price Index using index mining techniques and its component price indices: 2012 to 2023
authors: Yi-Sheng Chao Chao-Jung Wu a Independent Researchb Département d’informatique, Université du Québec à Montréal, Montreal, Canada
official: 官方在线 2025-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) aims to measure inflation. The CPI, published monthly by the US and measured by the price index of ‘All items’, is the sum of the products of component price indices and their relative weights. We analysed the CPI and its component price indices between 2012 and 2023. Based on the correlations between the CPI and its 358 component price indices, the CPI well represented the trends of most component price indices throughout the period. The time series regression coefficients of component indices did not necessarily match the relative weights. If measuring volatility with rolling standard deviations of raw values with 19 or more months time windows, the CPI was less volatile than the core CPI. The CPI is a good measure of relative price changes in most of the goods or services. However, some goods and services have prices fluctuating in patterns very different from that of the CPI. Policy implications include initiatives that focus on the management of macroeconomic risks, early policy responses using the leading indicators of inflation, policies to manage inflation propagation over time or across price indices, and strategies to refine inflation-linked payments.
abstract_zh: 消费者价格指数（CPI）旨在衡量通货膨胀。美国每月发布的CPI以“所有项目”价格指数衡量，是各成分价格指数与其相对权重乘积的总和。我们分析了2012年至2023年间的CPI及其成分价格指数。基于CPI与其358个成分价格指数之间的相关性，CPI在整个时期内较好地代表了大多数成分价格指数的趋势。成分指数的时间序列回归系数未必与其相对权重匹配。若采用19个月及以上时间窗口的原始值滚动标准差衡量波动性，CPI的波动性低于核心CPI。CPI是衡量大多数商品或服务相对价格变化的良好指标。然而，部分商品和服务的价格波动模式与CPI存在显著差异。政策启示包括：聚焦宏观经济风险管理的举措、利用通胀领先指标进行早期政策响应、管理通胀随时间或跨价格指数传导的政策，以及优化通胀挂钩支付策略。

title: Persuasion with Limited Data: A Case-Based Approach
title_zh: 有限数据下的说服：基于案例的方法
title_primary: 有限数据下的说服：基于案例的方法
title_secondary: Persuasion with Limited Data: A Case-Based Approach
authors: Shiri Alon, Sarah Auster, Gabi Gayer, Stefania Minardi
official: 官方在线 2023-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A strategic sender collects data with the goal of persuading a receiver to adopt a new action. The receiver assesses the profitability of adopting the action by following a classical statistics approach: she forms an estimate via the similarity-weighted empirical frequencies of outcomes in past cases, sharing some attributes with the problem at hand. The sender has control over the characteristics of the sampled cases and discloses the outcomes of his study truthfully. We characterize the sender's optimal sampling strategy as the outcome of a greedy algorithm. The sender provides more relevant data–consisting of observations sharing relatively more characteristics with the current problem–when the sampling capacity is low, when a large amount of initial public data is available, and when the estimated benefit of adoption according to this public data is low. Competition between senders curbs incentives for biasing the receiver's estimate and leads to more balanced datasets.
abstract_zh: 一位策略性信息发送者收集数据，旨在说服接收者采纳新行动。接收者遵循经典统计学方法评估采纳行动的盈利性：她通过相似性加权的历史案例结果经验频率形成估计，这些案例与当前问题共享部分属性。发送者可控制抽样案例的特征，并如实披露研究结果。我们通过贪心算法刻画了发送者的最优抽样策略：当抽样能力有限、可获取的初始公共数据量较大、或根据公共数据估算的采纳收益较低时，发送者会提供更多相关数据（即与当前问题共享更多特征的观测值）。发送者之间的竞争会抑制其扭曲接收者估计的动机，从而形成更均衡的数据集。
